probe_history.reason: A plain, unauthenticated GET of https://www.musikundfrieden.de/ (the venue's historically-known domain, per third-party discovery leads used only as leads, never as fact authority) returns HTTP 301 and redirects to https://hole-berlin.de/. That target's own retained homepage content (title 'Hole⁴⁴ - Berlin', meta description 'Club in Berlin Neukölln. Konzerte, Partys und Events. Hermannstraße 146, D-12051 Berlin', and its own schema.org Organization/WebSite JSON-LD naming 'Hole Berlin' at 'Hermannstraße 146, 12051 Berlin') directly and unambiguously identifies a different venue, under a different name, at a different address and district (Neukölln, not Kreuzberg) than Musik & Frieden (previously at Falckensteinstraße 47/48, Kreuzberg, near Schlesisches Tor). This single retained fetch fully answers the CANDIDATE_IDENTITY question: no current official first-party presence exists for Musik & Frieden at its own historically-known domain to investigate further. Independent third-party discovery leads (used only as leads per docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's 'Third-party sources' section, never as fact authority) corroborate this: multiple sources (berliner-zeitung.de journalism, theclubmap.com's own 'CLOSED' listing) independently report Musik & Frieden closed in 2020 (building slated for demolition; door marked 'Geschlossen wegen Covid-19'), with the same operators going on to run Hole44/Hole Berlin in Neukölln as an unofficial successor brand — a genuinely different venue, not a rename or relaunch of Musik & Frieden itself.
